title: Lysine Interacts with Frizzled7 to Activate beta-Catenin in Satellite Cell-Participated Skeletal Muscle Growth.
authors: Jin, Cheng-Long; Ye, Mao; Song, Zhi-Wen; Zhang, Zong-Ming; Gao, Chun-Qi; Yan, Hui-Chao; Wang, Xiu-Qi
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究赖氨酸与FZD7蛋白结合激活Wnt/β-catenin通路促进肌肉生长，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: This work provided an interesting finding of lysine (Lys) control on skeletal muscle growth besides protein synthesis. According to the isobaric tag for relative and absolute quantitation and molecular docking analyses, we found both in in vivo skeletal muscle and in vitro muscle satellite cells (MuSCs) that the frizzled7 (FZD7) expression level was positively correlated with Lys levels and this was consistent with the activation of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. On the other hand, FZD7 inhibition suppressed the Lys-rescued Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, FZD7 knockdown caused cell proliferation, and Wnt/beta-catenin pathway restrictions could not be compensated for by Lys or Wnt3a. Furthermore, the combination between Lys and recombinant pig frizzled7 (rpFZD7) protein was confirmed by isothermal titration calorimetry. This finding displayed concrete evidence that Lys is not only a molecular block of protein synthesis but is also a ligand for FZD7 to activate beta-catenin to stimulate MuSCs in promoting skeletal muscle growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究除了蛋白质合成外，还提供了一个关于赖氨酸（Lys）调控骨骼肌生长的有趣发现。根据同量异位标签相对和绝对定量及分子对接分析，我们在体内骨骼肌和体外肌肉卫星细胞（MuSCs）中发现，frizzled7（FZD7）表达水平与Lys水平呈正相关，这与Wnt/β-catenin通路的激活一致。另一方面，FZD7抑制抑制了Lys挽救的Wnt/β-catenin通路，FZD7敲低导致细胞增殖，而Wnt/β-catenin通路限制无法通过Lys或Wnt3a补偿。此外，通过等温滴定量热法确认了Lys与重组猪frizzled7（rpFZD7）蛋白之间的结合。这一发现提供了具体证据，表明Lys不仅是蛋白质合成的分子阻断剂，还是FZD7的配体，通过激活β-catenin刺激MuSCs，从而促进骨骼肌生长。
